title: Using latent-agent swarms for math discovery and optimization [R]
summary: Last year Google DeepMind's AlphaEvolve found a faster way to multiply 4x4 complex matrices, beating a record that had stood since 1969. The idea is to let an LLM write a program, score it, and iteratively improve it. So it's called "evolve". But AlphaEvolve runs on Gemini models
reason: Reddit discussion post about latent-agent swarms; no named model release, no link to an original paper/official source, and no repo or tool release. No active rule covers it.
